page_title: PSG 2-2 BRE | PSG v Brest 28/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+3' Bradley Barcola (PSG) makes a bad challenge and is given a second yellow card which means he's off.
90+2' Bradley Barcola (PSG) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' The substitution is prepared. Goncalo Ramos (PSG) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Vitinha.
89' A cross from a corner kick by PSG is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
87' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from PSG comes to nothing.
86' The shots on goal statistics – 4:6.
84' A corner kick by PSG is thwarted by the well prepared Marco Bizot (Brest).
81' Eric Roy has decided to substitute Bradley Locko and he is replaced by Julien Le Cardinal (Brest).
81' Here is a change. Romain Del Castillo is going off and Eric Roy gives the last tactical orders to Bilal Brahimi (Brest).
80' 2 - 2 GOAL! Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) finishes off a sublime move with a delightful back-heel goal. Martin Satriano provided the assist with a brilliant pass. 2:2.
77' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
75' It's time for a substitution. Marquinhos (PSG) comes on in place of Lucas Hernandez.
75' Luis Enrique decides to make a substitution. Marco Asensio will be replaced by Carlos Soler (PSG).
74' Bradley Barcola (PSG) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
72' Substitution. Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) in, Steve Mounie out.
72' Substitution. Mahdi Camara makes way for Jonas Martin (Brest).
69' Luis Enrique has decided to make a change. Ousmane Dembele (PSG) replaces Randal Kolo Muani.
68' Bradley Barcola (PSG) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post.
65' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Fabian Ruiz (PSG) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
63' Jeremy Le Douaron will be replaced by Martin Satriano (Brest).
61' Vitinha (PSG) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
59' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for PSG.
59' Lilian Brassier (Brest) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Clement Turpin had an easy-decision to make.
59' Bradley Barcola (PSG) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. PSG have a corner.
58' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
55' 2 - 1 Goal! Mahdi Camara (Brest) picks up the ball inside the box, finds himself in a good position and fires in a shot which is deflected past Gianluigi Donnarumma. He makes it 2:1.
53' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
53' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Kenny Lala (Brest) was quite harsh and Clement Turpin didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
53' What a wasted opportunity by Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest)! He unleashed a powerful low shot from the centre of the box, but Gianluigi Donnarumma makes a decent save to thwart him.
49' Clement Turpin couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) and blew his whistle.
47' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
47' A cross into the box from Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) is cleared.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' The current number of shots on goal is 3:1.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' 2 - 0 Goal! Randal Kolo Muani (PSG) is quickest to react to the rebound and stabs the ball into the back of the net. It's 2:0.
43' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
40' Bradley Locko (Brest) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

38' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Marco Asensio (PSG) scores with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Bradley Barcola. The score is now 1:0.
36' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
34' The game is interrupted. Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
32' Clement Turpin shows a yellow card to Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) for his blatant foul.
29' Lilian Brassier (Brest) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
26' Lucas Hernandez (PSG) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
24' PSG have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
24' Clement Turpin blows for a foul after Lucas Beraldo (PSG) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
23' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) climbs highest in the middle of the box after a cross from the wing, but sends a good looking header narrowly wide of the left post.
21' A lofted cross from Mahdi Camara (Brest) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
18' PSG can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
17' Randal Kolo Muani (PSG) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
16' Randal Kolo Muani (PSG) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Clement Turpin blows for a foul.
13' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
12' That didn't go as planned! Kylian Mbappe (PSG) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom left corner was too weak to get past Marco Bizot, who easily kept it out.
11' A pass from Lucas Hernandez (PSG) is intercepted by Marco Bizot and the move breaks down.
9' Vitinha (PSG) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
8' Steve Mounie (Brest) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Clement Turpin blows for a foul.
6' Kenny Lala (Brest) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
4' Vitinha (PSG) drives in a shot at goal, but the attempt from the edge of the box flashes just over the bar.
2' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
PSG will kick-off.
Clement Turpin is the one to supervise the game today.
